task: Execute the Multi-Model Ablation Research M0 readiness smoke so the project can tell whether a future Phase 1 campaign can run fairly.
outcome: The user can open experiments/multi-model-ablation/m0-status.md and see every Research M0 milestone marked pass or blocker, with a machine-checkable smoke command proving host/model separation, snapshot readiness, tool-surface equivalence, A2prime budget-lock ordering, legal contrast rules, and no Phase 1/2 campaign execution.
facts: Story B-f8c6 already promoted the multi-model ablation protocol and example artifacts.
Research M0 is paper-evidence readiness work, not a Proofbound product gate or runtime policy.

constraints: Do not run provider model cells or large Phase 1/2 campaigns in this story.
Keep all Research M0 artifacts under experiments/multi-model-ablation and story evidence under .lattice/story.
